Before you create your account
Please read and agree — scroll for all of it
• You must be 21 years or older to use this app. By continuing you confirm you are 21+.

• This app's AI predictions are guides only, based on patterns in past races.

• The game is random. No prediction can guarantee a win — even the best models are wrong ~1 in 5 times.

• You are fully responsible for your own bets and losses. This app is not responsible for any money you lose.

• Play at your own risk. Bet wisely. Greed leads to losses — never bet more than you can afford to lose.

• Set limits, take breaks, and stop when you're not enjoying it.

• Auto mode reads the game off your screen. Automating another app is very likely against that app's terms of service, and the account you play on could be suspended or banned for it. That is your risk to take, and you are taking it knowingly.

• Your races sync to the account that gave you access. The races you log, your win rates and your accuracy are stored in this app's shared database, and the owner of this app can see them. Do not use it for anything you would not want them to see.
